findings.title: Accepted Core material establishment breaks Rise playthrough views
findings.expected: Reject an unsupported material atomically, or retain a readable campaign with explicit unknown unit support.
reproduction: Create a reviewed R00 Rise campaign.
Observe the successful save and valid CoreWorld state.
GET /api/playthrough/<id> with the normal session token.
findings.boundary: IRGS_Web/rise_campaigns.py view indexes model.units[material]; Core stock establishment accepts material IDs without that unit binding.

findings.title: Canonical Core location records are incompatible with Rise location consumers
findings.expected: A supported, established location confirmation must leave local inventory and supported movement usable.
reproduction: Creator records and delivers established evidence placing the founder at commons.
Creator confirms founder.location=commons through confirm_character_field with authority and player instruction references.
Inspect local inventory and submit walk_clearing.
findings.boundary: Core confirm_character_field writes {value,evidence_id,at}; settlement_runtime.location and Rise view consume the whole record as a site string.
